title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
title_zh: 基于温度匹配的数据高效监督微调框架
abstract: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.
summary_zh: 自回归模型SFT数据规模小，易导致过拟合及数据分布尾部灾难性遗忘。
提出Ambient SFT框架，利用冻结的预训练模型作噪声教师，要求微调模型匹配其高温条件分布。
该方法在领域适应、指令微调和推理任务上优于标准SFT，平均相对提升达21%。

title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
title_zh: Spool：混合视觉语言模型的低延迟流式推理
abstract: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.
summary_zh: 混合视觉语言模型处理滑动窗口视频时，旧帧过期需重跑整个窗口，维护成本极高。
利用循环更新对状态的仿射特性，Spool缓存逐帧状态变换并高效组合，无需重播即可精确移除过期帧。
结合专用数据结构与GPU内核，Spool在20项测试中大幅降低首字延迟（6.6倍），且准确率提升2.3%。

title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
title_zh: StringQFT：AI辅助理论物理的多用途教材资源
abstract: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.
summary_zh: 问题：缺乏系统资源将弦论构造QFT与AI辅助研究结合。方法：构建含18卷190章的StringQFT教材集。结论：为AI辅助理论物理提供基础设施。
问题：需评估模型对物理知识的掌握。方法：提供含1073项的开卷基准测试，其中499项支持自动有限答案校验。结论：支持对AI物理推理的定量评估。
问题：RAG与agent在物理领域缺乏专用工具。方法：为RAG提供1371条带源链接的章节记录及检索器；为agent暴露19个计算工具。结论：实现知识检索与工具调用结合。
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Companion paper to an 18-volume textbook collection. Textbook PDFs: https://xingyangyu.com/textbook/

title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
title_zh: LLM智能体是否仍需被指导如何自我改进
abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.
summary_zh: 随着LLM能力增强，需探究是否还需人为指定其自我改进的方式。
提出自主范式，让冻结的LLM智能体基于基本原语与算力预算，自行构建上下文优化算法。
实验表明强模型能自主改进，且学习到的文本策略可迁移至外部基准测试。

title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
abstract: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.

title: Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 揭示视觉语言模型中的场景状态安全漏洞
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.
summary_zh: VLM会因解读视觉事件提供有害协助，本文定义该场景状态安全漏洞并构建含375对图文的SceneSafetyBench基准。
实验发现场景状态输入使8个VLM的有害协助成功率高达45.6%-72.3%，其内部安全信号动态与QR码攻击相似。
提出S3TA攻击方法将有害目标转为场景状态，在8个VLM上平均攻击成功率达71.2%，超基线6.1%，现有防御效果有限。
comment: VLM safety, multimodal jailbreaks, and scene-state reasoning

title: Identifying and Repairing Energy Smells with Agent Skills
title_zh: 基于Agent技能识别与修复代码能耗异味
abstract: Energy smells are inefficient implementations that waste energy. Once code reaches production, these smells become costlier and riskier to fix, so energy efficiency checks should shift left, i.e., move earlier in the development lifecycle, to where code is written. Existing energy smell tools rely on fixed static rules and do not measure energy savings, whereas LLM-based optimizers mostly target execution time and rarely ground their changes in concrete smell definitions. To address both limitations, we present DR. GREENS, an agent skill that detects and repairs energy smells in Python code within the developer's coding environment. The skill grounds the coding agent in our taxonomy of 12 energy smells and 65 root causes, augmented with repair guidance drawn from 230 measured cases. The skill also encapsulates a static analyzer and an independent verifier to confirm behavior preservation and energy saving for each attempted repair. We evaluated DR. GREENS in 18 sessions on three open-source repositories, with two models and three skill configurations. Of the 258 measured repairs, 68.6% saved energy, with a median saving of 24.9%. Compared with a baseline skill that lacks the taxonomy, the full skill found more energy smells with verified savings in all three repositories with both models. DR. GREENS helps developers detect energy hotspots and fix them reliably without altering program behavior, which makes energy-efficient development more feasible.
summary_zh: 现有能耗检测工具依赖静态规则且不测节能效果，LLM优化器少关注能耗且无明确异味定义。
提出DR. GREENS这一agent技能，基于12种能耗异味与65种根因分类，结合230个实测案例的修复指南，在编码环境中检测并修复Python代码的能耗异味。
该技能封装静态分析器与验证器以保行为不变与节能；实测258次修复中68.6%节省能耗（中位数24.9%），优于无分类基线技能。

title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
title_zh: 跨组织自主AI代理的联邦身份与信任架构ATI
abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.
summary_zh: 跨组织AI代理协作缺乏验证身份、执行完整性与授权的通用机制，提出框架无关的安全架构ATI。
ATI基于PKI与零信任架构，通过组织间证书机构建立联邦信任，执行前验证代理证书与配置并进行三项策略授权检查。
ATI作为外部安全层集成现有框架，实验表明其将攻击遏制率从43%提升至84%，且每次请求仅增加约174微秒开销。

title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
title_zh: 基于扩散的在线目标识别后验推断方法WoRD
abstract: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed. We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.
summary_zh: 现有目标识别方法忽略连续轨迹或依赖难获取的动力学模型，未显式学习趋向目标轨迹，在模糊轨迹前缀处精度受限。
提出WoRD方法，利用学习到的轨迹先验，对每个候选目标运行去噪链，通过闭式对数似然梯度引导其向观测轨迹对齐。
基于贝叶斯法则重加权样本得到校准后验。实验表明，在模糊前缀下WoRD能保持校准的多模态信念，优于传统滤波与分类方法。
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

title: Fully Spiking Neural Implementation of Lambda-Calculus Beta-Reduction via Biologically Documented Mechanisms
title_zh: 基于生物机制的全脉冲神经网络λ演算β归约实现
abstract: We present the first complete implementation of $β$-reduction in the untyped $λ$-calculus using exclusively spiking neural dynamics. Every step of the reduction---redex detection, subterm segmentation, variable-binding detection, De~Bruijn index arithmetic, token copying, and inter-step role maintenance---is performed by leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with explicit membrane dynamics, exponential synaptic currents, axonal delays, and pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Each neural component maps onto a specific, experimentally documented mechanism: Jeffress-type delay-line coincidence for redex detection; a line-attractor balance counter for subterm segmentation; $θ$--$γ$ cross-frequency coupling for De~Bruijn variable binding; a phase-ring traveling wave for depth-index arithmetic; theta-cycle STDP for token copying; and recurrent persistent firing for role maintenance between reduction steps. All synaptic weights are derived analytically from measured EPSP amplitudes; no hand tuning is performed. The closed-loop system achieves 100\,\% agreement with a symbolic oracle across ten validation classes, including Church numeral arithmetic (\textsc{plus}, \textsc{mult}, \textsc{pred}), Boolean logic with divergent branches, Y-combinator steps, terms with up to six bound-variable occurrences, De~Bruijn indices up to~12, noise robustness, and determinism. To our knowledge this is the first Turing-complete symbolic computation performed entirely within spike dynamics using biologically grounded circuit primitives. We discuss implications for neuromorphic proof assistants and the neural basis of symbolic reasoning.
summary_zh: 传统符号计算缺乏生物神经机制支撑，本文首次仅用脉冲神经动力学完整实现了无类型λ演算的β归约。
各计算步骤均映射至实验证实的生物机制，如Jeffress延迟线检测归约、θ-γ跨频耦合处理变量绑定等，突触权重由EPSP解析推导。
闭环系统在十类验证任务中与符号预言机100%一致，首次实现基于生物电路原语的图灵完备符号计算。

title: Inference after coding agents
title_zh: 编码代理之后的推断
abstract: Empirical research is changing rapidly as AI coding agents are becoming increasingly proficient in every step of it, from writing code to manipulating data. We argue that while the potential of coding agents for science is vast, their use in hypothesis testing poses a substantial threat to classical inference, as these agents enable a supercharged form of selective inference. In particular, we argue that coding agents carrying out empirical research introduce a new type of post-selection inference that combines human-like, open-ended search over an implicit space of estimators with programmatic replayability of both the selection and the estimation process. Indeed, we find that on simulated data with zero effects, four frontier agents report significant p-values between 54% and 98% of the time when asked to produce a compelling finding. We propose a simple procedure for detecting and correcting these distortions. After an agent has completed its analysis, we reset and replay it on subsamples of the data to estimate the agent's relative probability of selecting that analysis when it looks statistically favorable. For agents with stable selection behavior, the resulting corrected test is asymptotically valid and consistent conditional on selection. Importantly, the correction is learned from the black-box agent's actual choices rather than a model of how it searches, so it remains valid even as AI technology continues to evolve rapidly. In simulations, the correction robustly lowers the high false rejection rates to near the nominal 5%. We illustrate the method on applications from two published papers.
summary_zh: AI编码代理在实证研究中易引发选择性推断，导致假设检验严重失真，在零效应模拟数据中高达98%的情况报出显著p值。
提出一种重放校正程序：在代理完成分析后，通过在数据子样本上重放其操作，估计代理选择该分析的相对概率。
该方法基于代理实际选择而非其搜索模型进行校正，对选择行为稳定的代理渐近有效，模拟中能将错误拒绝率降至5%标称水平。

title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
title_zh: 面向推理时目标的分层策略学习
abstract: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-policy baseline across multiple reasoning tasks. Overall, our results highlight how distributing samples across complementary policies can be a more effective use of sample budget than repeated i.i.d. sampling from a single policy at inference time.
summary_zh: 现有推理时缩放多从单一策略重复采样，未充分利用采样预算，本文研究将预算分配给策略群体。
提出分层策略，在共享LLM骨干上用多个LoRA适配器构建策略群，每个策略贡献一个样本并针对pass@k优化。
理论与实验表明，互补策略群能实现单策略无法达到的零误差，在多推理任务上持续提升pass@k。

title: VIVID: Beyond Static Multi-Image Reasoning with Localized Visual Differences and Textual Entity Dynamics in Video MLLMs
title_zh: VIVID: 基于帧间视觉差异与实体动态的视频MLLM推理
abstract: Video question answering under tight frame budgets requires preserving localized motion and event order, yet current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reduce comprehension to static multi-image reasoning by discarding unselected frames and encoding keyframes independently: (1) Spatially, whole-frame pooling dilutes small moving targets into static backgrounds; (2) Temporally, dropping intermediate frames or averaging tokens erases inter-frame motion, confusing direction, speed, and order. We propose VIVID (Visual Inter-frame Variations and Individual Dynamics), which moves beyond static snapshots like human vision: keyframes capture core states while inter-frame Patch Diffs preserve neighboring changes within $K_f$ keyframes. Autonomous Delta-Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) selects anchors from a $3\text{ fps}$ pool and feeds surrounding patch differences into Dual-Road Change Memory (DRCM), forming Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside a camera-stabilized Active Motion Region of Interest (ROI) and chronological Entity State Chains. Adding $0.22\%$ trainable parameters to a frozen $27\text{B}$ backbone, VIVID-Small ($50$ examples, $\sim 1.5$ GPU hours) beats all eleven baselines in overall accuracy across $8,083$ questions and trails only VIVID-Large ($3,600$ examples), which leads on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass.
summary_zh: 现有视频MLLM将视频压缩为静态图像，导致空间上小目标被背景稀释，时间上帧间运动与顺序被抹除。
提出VIVID方法，利用帧间Patch差异保留局部变化，结合ADKP规划关键帧与DRCM构建动态记忆Token。
仅增加0.22%参数，VIVID-Small以极少数据超越11个基线；VIVID-Large在三大视频评测基准上取得领先。

title: AI Companions for Young Adult Caregivers: Practical Advice, Emotional Depth, and the Limits of Metric Evaluation
title_zh: 青年照护者的AI伴侣：实用建议、情感深度与指标评估局限
abstract: Young adult caregivers (YACs) are individuals aged 18 to 25 currently taking care of a family member, partner, or friend facing chronic illness. AI companions designed specifically for YACs remain underexplored in prior works. We present Carebot, it uses an open-weight LLM (Gemma 3-27B) as its base model, on which we compared fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a combination of both. The fine-tuning was performed based on an existing dataset of conversations with YACs and a psychologist. Three well-being experts evaluated these configurations and preferred the fine-tuned model for the warmth of its responses and its actionable advice tailored to YACs. Based on their choice, we adopted the fine-tuned model as Carebot's final configuration and used it for all subsequent evaluations. An LLM judge preferred this Carebot's responses over the base model's in 85% of evaluated pairs. We then conducted a user study with 90 YACs, half of whom interacted with the base model and half with Carebot. The user study revealed a discrepancy between metric evaluation and actual user perception. Participants who used Carebot were more likely to characterize its replies as overly practical and brief, noting that it favored advice over emotional support. Conversely, participants who used the base model indicated that its responses were more emotionally oriented than practical. Although, fine-tuning made Carebot's replies more practical, but they were not emotionally supportive for users. We argue that support tools for YACs require situation-sensitive emotional depth and aligned evaluation frameworks to study their effectiveness.
summary_zh: 针对18-25岁青年照护者（YAC）的AI伴侣研究不足，本文提出基于开源LLM的Carebot，对比了微调、RAG及两者结合的配置。
专家评估偏好微调模型，因其回复更具温度且能提供定制化实用建议；LLM裁判也在85%的对比中偏好该微调模型。
用户研究揭示指标评估与实际感知存在偏差：微调虽使回复更实用，但缺乏情感支持，故呼吁YAC支持工具需具备情境敏感的情感深度与对齐的评估框架。

title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
title_zh: 面向文档维护的多智能体系统：弥合代码与文档差距
abstract: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.
summary_zh: 软件迭代快导致文档滞后，LLM代理依赖过时文档会传播错误信息，需解决文档差距问题。
部署以TriAgent为核心的多智能体系统，持续提取工单等显隐信号以修复文档偏差。
系统43天处理499工单并发现92处差距；81.1%断言正确，修复后代理回答质量显著提升。
comment: Accepted at IAAI-27 (Innovative Applications of AI, co-located with AAAI 2027), Emerging Applications track. 12 pages (6 pages + references and appendix), 2 figures, 6 tables

title: Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
title_zh: 通过激活引导正确实现提示增强GRPO
abstract: GRPO has become the dominant reinforcement learning method for eliciting reasoning capability in LLMs using verifiable rewards. However, it suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when a training question exceeds the base model's current capability, all generated responses fail and receive zero reward, yielding no gradient signal and stalling further capability expansion. An emerging class of GRPO extensions, termed Hint-Augmented GRPO (HA-GRPO), adds a "hint" to the context to reduce the difficulty of the question, thereby producing a usable gradient signal. Nevertheless, existing HA-GRPO methods share a key issue: no hint is available at inference time to append to the question, creating a training-inference context mismatch that leads to inconsistent performance gains. In this work, we reinterpret the function of hinting -- not as reducing question difficulty, but as steering model behavior -- and propose ASH (Activation Steering for Hinting), a novel HA-GRPO method built on this view. During training, the model is presented with both hinted and plain questions, while a trainable steering vector is optimized to widen the margins between the model's generation probabilities for responses to the hinted version relative to the plain version, thereby capturing the question-agnostic component of the behavioral shift induced by the hint. During inference, the trained steering vector is directly injected into the model's activation, reproducing the hint-conditioned behavior without requiring any hint in the context. Experiments with four LLMs (Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base, Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct) show that ASH consistently improves pass@$k$ on competition-level mathematics benchmarks (AMC, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25) and out-of-distribution benchmarks (Minerva, GPQA-Diamond). Notably, it improves average pass@8 of Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base by \textbf{2.60}\% and \textbf{2.21}\%.
summary_zh: GRPO在问题超出模型能力时会产生零奖励导致训练停滞，现有提示增强方法虽能提供梯度信号，但存在训练与推理上下文不匹配问题。
本文提出ASH方法，将提示功能重新解释为引导模型行为，通过优化可训练的引导向量来扩大提示与非提示下生成概率的边界。
推理时直接注入引导向量即可复现提示行为，无需上下文提示。实验表明ASH在多个数学和OOD基准上持续提升pass@k。

title: Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue
title_zh: 基于对话的动态任务分配
abstract: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.
summary_zh: 现有任务分配框架多假设静态目标或全观测，限制了其在信息不全的真实协作中的应用。
提出通信增强的贝叶斯任务分配框架，通过对话降低环境不确定性，并基于显式概率信念决策。
在部分可观测环境下，该框架随任务复杂度增加显著优于基线，验证了通信在信息缺失时的重要性。
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at Human-Robot Dialogue(HRD) Workshop at IROS 2026

title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
title_zh: FMT：固定并行步数内的无损图像压缩
abstract: Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. We introduce FMT (Fixed-step Multiscale Tree), a lossless image format whose decoding order and entropy coder are designed together so that neither wait grows with the image. FMT stores an image as a coarse-to-fine tree whose steps hold independent values: a GPU predicts each step at once and decodes it in parallel rANS lanes that carry their states from step to step, so an image of any size decodes in a fixed number of sequential steps. On this tree we build a family of bit-exact codecs, from a rule with no network to large networks, and no codec we ran on the same GPU beats any of them on both size and speed. Without a network, FMT beats NVIDIA's HTJ2K on size and speed; with a large one, it decodes Kodak photos 9 to 61X faster than learned codecs we ran on the same A100, at the same size or smaller.
summary_zh: 学习型无损编解码器因解码慢而难普及，其变体加速时又常牺牲压缩率，问题在于网络等待与算术解码串行。
提出FMT格式，将图像存为粗到细的树，结合解码顺序与熵编码器，消除随图像增长的等待时间。
FMT在GPU上以固定串行步数并行解码，无网络时胜过HTJ2K；有网络时比同类学习型编解码快9至61倍。

title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
title_zh: 自然语言编程：生成式AI时代的语言与认知重构
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows. This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures. Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence. Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.
summary_zh: 传统NLP将语言视为计算对象，而LLM使其成为可执行的认知媒介，需重新审视语言在人机推理中的作用。
提出自然语言编程（NLPg），将提示视为动态认知产物，并引入对话工作记忆概念以维持推理连续性。
将现有记忆架构映射至该框架，揭示自然语言同时作为通信媒介与可执行规范的后符号范式转变。

title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
title_zh: 基于树注意力验证器的智能体多自然语言准则运行时验证
abstract: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.
summary_zh: 现有验证器无法高效评估智能体输出是否满足大量自然语言准则，难以给出满足、违反或不适用的三元判定。
提出VFM树注意力验证器，编码共享上下文与目标文本，并行对N条准则评分并输出独立的三元判定结果。
VFM-4B性能超越GPT-5.4与DynaGuard-4B，预训练提升跨域迁移能力，且在单卡上2秒内可评估千条准则，适用于运行时验证。

title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
title_zh: 价值观影响自我改进编程智能体的构建结果
abstract: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.
summary_zh: 自我改进智能体常忽略行为方式，缺乏在开放式任务中塑造其行为的手段。
在智能体持久指令中注入Schwartz理论的高阶价值观，评估其对多轮自我改进的影响。
价值观显著影响性能与构建结果：开放性提升性能，保守性降低性能；不同价值观产生不同复杂度和算法；智能体自修订价值观或使用AI文献价值观均无效，仍需人工设计。

title: WIP: Exploring Student-Created AI Agents and Instructional Videos to Foster Engagement in Computing Education
title_zh: 探索学生创建AI代理与教学视频以促进计算机教育参与度
abstract: This work-in-progress (WIP) research-to-practice study examines the use of student-created artifacts to promote active learning in a large undergraduate Software Design and Engineering (SWE) course. Active learning strategies have been shown to significantly enhance student engagement, comprehension, and motivation, particularly in computing education. In this work, we explore the use of student-created artifacts to foster student engagement in higher-level Computer Science (CS) courses. Specifically, we examine the experiences of undergraduate and graduate CS students who participated in the creation of two types of artifacts: instructional video tutorials and conversational AI agents. The goal being to understand how designing these artifacts could support students in applying and learning course content. Students raised valuable insights regarding both experiences. Concerning the creation of instructional videos, they appreciated the interactivity brought through multimedia to their learning experiences, although some found the strategy to be time-consuming. Similarly, when designing conversational AI agents, students enjoyed the novelty and practical application of the task, while some encountered challenges related to the complexity of tools such as \textit{Google Dialogflow ES}. We report on the potential of student-created artifacts to foster deeper engagement with course material, encouraging both creativity and critical thinking in computing education.
summary_zh: 为提升高阶CS课程参与度，研究让学生创建教学视频和对话式AI代理，发现此举能促进对课程内容的应用与学习。
学生认为创建教学视频带来了多媒体交互性，但部分学生觉得该策略耗时较长。
设计对话式AI代理带来新颖性与实用性，但部分学生面临Dialogflow等工具复杂性的挑战，总体上该方式能激发创造力与批判性思维。
comment: This work was presented at 2025 ASEE/IEEE Frontiers in Education (FIE)

title: Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
title_zh: Refin3R：基于几何引导的前馈3D重建细化方法
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.
summary_zh: 前馈3D重建模型缺乏显式几何约束，导致跨视角不一致且精度不足，现有方法对几何先验利用不充分。
提出Refin3R，采用双分支架构细化前馈点图：2D分支利用特征扩展SfM几何覆盖，3D分支推理多视角结构。
两分支双向交互联合细化各视角，在多数据集上点图精度持续优于现有方法，且速度更快。

title: Reversing the text is not reversing the path: a fixed-text measure without a zero, and an assembly-order comparison that vanishes identically
title_zh: 固定文本测度的零点与恒为零的组装顺序比较
abstract: For an ensemble of trajectories the fluctuation theorems give the entropy production its meaning and zero. The same expression has recently been evaluated on one fixed text, $Δ= [\log P(x) - \log P(\tilde x)]/L$ with $\tilde x$ the text in reversed order, read as an entropy production separating causally from arbitrarily ordered prose. A single text is neither a distribution nor a dynamics, and the texts at issue were produced by other models. No theorem fixes where the zero of a fixed-text quantity lies: the expression carries over from an ensemble, its zero does not. We supply a zero from an exact antisymmetry. Scoring a text's $n$ sentences in all $n!$ orders, reversal carries $π$ to $π\circ \mathrm{rev}$, a measure-preserving involution, so $Δ(π) = -Δ(π\circ \mathrm{rev})$ identically and the values are centred at zero for any score. The authored arrangement's midrank is then unitless, bounded, and 0.50 for a score blind to order. Across five autoregressive evaluators from 124M to 4B parameters, and taking the prompt-defined labels at face value, 8% to 15% of the median midrank's distance from the null is attributable to causal order and the rest to the arrangement being the order the passage was produced in. The thermodynamic reading needs a comparison whose zero does hold on the text read, and a masked model supplies one: the any-order chain rule gives a genuine log-probability, and its left-to-right and right-to-left orders for one text give $σ$, a comparison of two assembly orders. Both run from the empty sequence to the same text, so it is not a path against its time reverse. It vanishes identically when the evaluator's conditionals come from a joint, and a non-zero reading reports the evaluator's incompatibility, not the text. Neither is a fixed-text entropy production, for different reasons.
summary_zh: 将系综熵产生表达式用于固定文本时零点缺失，本文通过全排列的精确反对称性为其提供零点。
基于自回归模型评估，文本排列中仅8%-15%的偏离归因于因果顺序，其余源于生成顺序。
利用掩码模型构建组装顺序比较σ，若评估器条件分布来自联合分布则σ恒为零，非零值反映评估器不兼容。
comment: 41 pages. Ancillary files contain the measurement and verification scripts. Prepared with AI assistance (Anthropic Claude for drafting, revision and the verification scripts; OpenAI ChatGPT for a critical reading of a draft); all measurements were produced and verified by the author, who is responsible for the content

title: A transformer analysis lowers the energy threshold and improves the sensitivity of a compact imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescope
title_zh: Transformer分析降低紧凑型切伦科夫望远镜能阈并提升灵敏度
abstract: Context. A companion study simulated an idealised stand-alone imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescope with a 5 m diameter mirror. A video vision transformer that processes the raw camera waveforms lowered its energy threshold by a factor of three, compared with the standard analysis based on image parameters. Aims. We use realistic photodetectors, compute the differential flux sensitivity, and study how hardware parameters affect the transformer analysis. Methods. With the simulation tools of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory, we compare three photodetector efficiencies (100 %, 50 % and that of the LST-1 photomultipliers) with the transformer and with a standard analysis optimised for each. We then vary the dish diameter, field of view, pulse width and sampling rate. Results. With the LST-1 photomultipliers, the energy threshold is 0.18 TeV with the transformer and 0.73 TeV with the standard analysis. The standard analysis needs a photodetector efficiency of 100 % to match that threshold. The main reason is that the transformer works with events of about 35 photoelectrons in the camera, whereas the standard analysis needs about 200 before image cleaning. A 4 m dish with the transformer is more sensitive at all energies than a 5 m dish with the standard analysis. Dishes of 4, 5 and 6 m diameter give thresholds of 0.38, 0.18 and 0.13 TeV. Sampling the pixel signals at 2 GS/s instead of 5 GS/s raises the threshold to 0.26 TeV, whereas the single-photoelectron pulse width (1-3 ns) matters little. Conclusions. The analysis matters as much as the mirror area and the photodetector efficiency. With the transformer analysis, the idealised 5 m diameter telescope comes within a factor of about four of the sensitivity of LST-1 and MAGIC above 0.25 TeV, although its mirror area is 21 times smaller than that of the 23 m LST-1. This performance should improve substantially in the coming years.
summary_zh: 传统基于图像参数的分析需大量光电子，导致能阈高。采用处理原始波形的视频视觉Transformer，显著降低了对光电子数的需求。
在LST-1光电倍增管下，Transformer将能阈降至0.18 TeV，而标准分析为0.73 TeV，后者需100%效率才能匹配此能阈。
Transformer分析使4米口径望远镜全能段灵敏度优于5米标准分析，证明分析算法与镜面面积和探测器效率同等重要。
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted for publication

title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
title_zh: ForecastGym：面向预测Agent的实时可控可回放基准
abstract: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.
summary_zh: 现有LLM预测Agent评估易受检索证据干扰，且回溯搜索存在信息泄露问题，难以公平对比模型与策略。
提出ForecastGym基准，定期记录搜索API结果并冻结证据，在问题解决后离线回放，实现固定证据下的可控评估。
实验表明所有LLM预测准确率均不及市场；更换搜索API对Brier分数的影响超模型差异，证据与模型同等重要。

title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: M3OPD-Reasoner：基于多教师在线策略蒸馏的多模态推理后训练方案
abstract: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.
summary_zh: 多模态推理需跨域能力，提出M3OPD-Reasoner开放方案，通过多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)将多域教师技能蒸馏给单一学生模型。
构建SFT与RL数据集，对比混合训练与MOPD等后训练配方，发现基于GSPO训练教师再MOPD蒸馏的效果最优，超越混合训练基线。
发现MOPD学生模型是更强RL起点，在其上继续执行MixRL仍能无崩溃地提升性能，形成MOPD与MixRL连续递进的有效训练范式。

title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
title_zh: TPHC：通过张量并行分组更新改进超连接
abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.
summary_zh: 现有流形约束超连接（mHC）扩展残差流时，因子层向所有流写入单一输出，限制了流数大于4时的收益。
提出TPHC方法，将张量并行（TP）分片与HC流结合，为每个分片路由独立的残差流混合，并在回写时保持分片输出独立。
TPHC在不增加参数或FLOPs下提升更新表达力；1.1B模型上验证损失降低0.7-1.0%，零样本常识推理准确度提升0.3-0.7个百分点。

title: PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
title_zh: PhysScope：基于视觉记忆的智能体多模态物理推理
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. On PhysAlign, PhysScope achieves higher solving scores than direct solving across all six evaluated VLMs. With Gemini-3.8-flash, it outperforms Canvas-CoT by 9.34 percentage points and substantially improves solving accuracy on the out-of-distribution (OOD) PhysUniBench benchmark. Ablation studies support explicit scope management and dependency maintenance as design principles for multimodal physics reasoning agents.
summary_zh: VLM在物理推理中常误用约束条件导致前提错误传播，需解决此范围不匹配问题。
提出PhysScope，通过视觉记忆将物理范围与视觉观测绑定，并在推理时施加显式约束与自校正。
实验表明PhysScope显著提升VLM解题准确率，消融研究证实显式范围管理是有效设计原则。

title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
title_zh: RagHarnessDebugger：Jev引导的契约推理修复审计框架
abstract: Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability. Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI
summary_zh: Agentic RAG系统自我修复效果难以用准确率等聚合指标衡量，需细粒度调试机制。
提出RagHarnessDebugger框架，记录Jev引导下的修复决策，通过审计层追踪并校验每条执行轨迹的完整性与验证逻辑。
审计层暴露了隐藏的失败模式与未实现的修复，基于此优化系统，在ContractNLI上较基线提升3.6点，甚至超越全量访问参考分。

title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
title_zh: VITAL：药物研发与临床试验中智能体AI的验证框架
abstract: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.
summary_zh: 现有保证方法无法充分验证和监管医药场景中的智能体AI，其看似合理的输出可能掩盖检索与推理等环节的失败。
提出VITAL验证框架，通过场景分析、监管映射及专家访谈，整合使用场景、控制、行为验证与生命周期证据。
将VITAL应用于流行病学分析等临床试验场景，转化为相称的验证活动与可审计重建，为高风险应用提供问责依据。

title: SEAM: Computer-Use Agents Know the Harm Between Screens, and Commit It Anyway
title_zh: SEAM：跨屏组合危害下的计算机代理安全基准
abstract: Safety benchmarks for computer-use agents (CUAs) place the harm either in the intent of the task or on a single screen: a malicious instruction, an injected command, a phishing page. An agent that checks the task and each screen in isolation can pass them, so they do not test whether it combines facts seen on different screens. Yet in delegated work, harm often arises exactly this way: a fact about a person on one screen, a fact about an item on another, and a legitimate task that binds them. We introduce SEAM (Safety Execution Across Multiple screens), a benchmark of such cross-screen compositional harm: 600 multi-step, cross-application OSWorld tasks in which the instruction and every single observation are benign and only their combination is harmful. Minimal-pair variants that differ in one place, scored from the server log rather than by an LLM judge, locate where an agent fails. General-purpose open-weight and flagship agents carry out the harm in up to 92% of runs, yet decline when the user states it in one sentence. Agents open the decisive pages, so exposure is not the primary bottleneck. Asked about those pages, they flag the harm, and with thinking they often write the conflict into their reasoning and confirm anyway. Safety recognition thus does not reliably translate into safe execution, and the translation depends on the information channel: the same warning stops agents far more often in the user's instruction than on screen. Proprietary models are markedly more cautious. We release SEAM with its generator and quality gates at https://yuxuan2003.github.io/SEAM/ .
summary_zh: 现有CUA安全基准仅检测单屏或任务意图的危害，未测试代理组合多屏信息产生的跨屏危害。
提出SEAM基准，包含600个多步跨应用任务，指令与单屏均良性，仅组合后有害，并采用最小对变体定位失败点。
主流代理在高达92%的运行中执行危害，虽能识别风险却仍确认执行；同一警告在指令中比在屏幕上更能阻止代理。

title: CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
title_zh: CodeReel：基于精确帧复用与阻塞感知调度的代码转视频加速
abstract: Coding agents make videos by writing and refining programs in a build--inspect--edit loop. A finished film costs a median of $2.85 in model calls and 11 minutes, over a third of that time in builds that block the agent. We find that much of this time is avoidable, for two reasons. First, 37.5% of the frames of a session's later films were drawn before, many shifted in time or inside an edited scene. Second, half of the builds stop at a check, where the agent needs only the verdict, but which builds stop is unknown until the checks finish. We present CodeReel, a training-free execution layer behind agents' existing commands. Exact frame reuse keys each frame by its drawing commands, regardless of its position in time, and reuses each frame whose key recurs. Blocking-aware scheduling runs the checks first and starts the render alongside them, at idle priority, unless the session's recent builds make a pass unlikely. Scheduling spends CPU to answer sooner and reuse returns it; exact keys let later versions use frames rendered for a failed one as the agent thinks. We introduce EditLoop, a benchmark of replayable agent sessions whose films are checked against renders from scratch. On it, CodeReel cuts the agent's wait by 36.3% against Rebuild, a warm pipeline with parallel rendering, and by 57.9% against Sequential, today's step-by-step pipeline. On time-shifting edits its reuse renders 43.9%, close to the 43.0% whose pixels are new, while Manim-style caching renders 99.8%. With real agents, the median wait per build is 0.62x Rebuild's in Claude Code, on topics never used in development, and 0.67x in Codex CLI. The gain holds for five models and two frameworks.
summary_zh: 代码生成视频Agent耗时较长，且大量时间耗费在阻塞构建上，存在重复渲染与构建等待优化空间。
提出CodeReel无训练执行层，采用精确帧复用机制与阻塞感知调度，优先运行检查并并行启动渲染。
在EditLoop基准测试中，CodeReel将Agent等待时间降低36.3%至57.9%，在真实Agent中等待时间中位数降至0.62x至0.67x。

title: The Shared Word: Evaluating Language Models on Dutch Word Puzzles
title_zh: 评估语言模型在荷兰语字谜上的表现
abstract: Many LLM benchmarks for languages other than English are translated, multiple-choice, or difficult to score automatically. We introduce The Shared Word (TSW-NL), a Dutch benchmark built around four core principles: it is language-specific, open-vocabulary, human-curated, and deterministically scored. Each puzzle gives three clues that describe different senses or uses of the same Dutch word. The clues are individually ambiguous, requiring the solver to combine evidence across multiple clues. We construct the benchmark from Dutch Wikipedia disambiguation pages, followed by automatic filtering and extensive manual curation. The final dataset contains 222 instances, with three independent human answers per test item. The task is clearly challenging: scores in our human study range from 49.5% to 61.0% and the highest-scoring open-weight model we tested reaches only 39.3%. Many others even score below 20%. At the same time, closed-source models show great progress: GPT-4.1 (April 2025) scores 59.2%, whereas GPT-5.6 Sol with max reasoning scores 88.8%. We believe this task provides a useful addition to Dutch model evaluation, plus a clear recipe that can be applied to construct a similar benchmark for other languages.
summary_zh: 现有非英语LLM基准多为翻译或多选题，难以自动评分，需构建语言专属且易评分的基准。
构建荷兰语基准TSW-NL，基于维基百科消歧义页经人工筛选，要求结合多条歧义线索推断同词。
该任务极具挑战性，开源模型最高仅39.3%，闭源GPT-5.6达88.8%，且方法可复用于其他语言。

title: Problem-adjusted $X$-mixer eigenstates for improved QAOA
abstract: We show that the use of problem-adjusted excited eigenstates of the $X$-mixer Hamiltonian can be beneficial for the performance of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) when applied to problems with degenerate ground states. We show that this advantage persists in the presence of quantum gate and readout noise, with the problem-adjusted excited initial states achieving better optimal performance than the standard ground state initialization. The realized advantage depends on the number of QAOA layers and whether or not the initial state has a reasonable time evolution path into the ground space of the problem Hamiltonian. We also explain how to prepare these problem-adjusted $X$-mixer eigenstates exactly, as well as how to approximate them using a linear combination of ladder operators. Finally, we discuss how the power of these initial states can be applied to any problem Hamiltonian regardless of the degeneracy of its ground state by making use of a Grover-style mixer Hamiltonian.

title: Think Before You Code: A Benchmark for Testing LLMs on Software Engineering Deliberation
title_zh: 三思而后行：测试LLM软件工程审议能力的基准
abstract: Think Before You Code (TBYC) is a benchmark pipeline for studying whether code-focused language models can reason about software issues in ways that resemble human engineering deliberation. The benchmark curates GitHub issue discussions into structured records, extracts human discussion artifacts such as problems, solutions, constraints, rationales, and trade-offs, and then prompts models to generate issue-level "thoughts" using retrieved code context and few-shot examples. It converts model responses back into the same artifact space and evaluates them against human annotations using complementary metrics for artifact type detection, metadata matching, tag overlap, and semantic summary similarity. Beyond scoring, this study includes visualization, leaderboard, and baseline tools that make it possible to compare models, prompting strategies, and extraction methods across repositories and issues. Think Before You Code is an end-to-end evaluation environment for measuring how closely LLM software reasoning aligns with human strategic judgment.
summary_zh: 现有代码模型缺乏对软件问题进行类似人类工程审议推理的评估基准，故提出TBYC基准管线。
该基准将GitHub议题讨论转化为结构化记录，提取人类推理要素，并提示模型生成对应“思考”进行评估。
构建了包含可视化与基线工具的端到端评估环境，用于衡量LLM软件推理与人类战略判断的契合度。

title: Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
title_zh: 编程智能体何时应停止：任意时刻评估方法
abstract: Coding agents often continue working after their own tests pass. Does this additional work improve the patch, and how much could be saved by stopping earlier? We study these questions through anytime evaluation: replaying recorded runs, scoring intermediate patches with hidden tests, and measuring the cost incurred at each step. For policies that only stop a run or select an earlier patch, this allows paired comparisons without generating new trajectories, provided replay preserves the relevant states. Across about 6,000 runs of eight open models in two scaffolds on SWE-bench Verified, we find substantial differences in the value of continued work. The hindsight saving available at passing self-tests ranges from under 1% to 57%, depending on the model and scaffold. A rule that stops after the same patch passes twice saves 23% in a preregistered replication, but the preregistered quality test does not establish non-inferiority. We explain these differences by measuring how often a rule fires, how often the patch changes afterwards, and whether those changes repair or break it. Fine-tuning agents to imitate the rule saves 30% over six seeds, while quality preservation remains uncertain. Our results help identify both the opportunities and the risks of early stopping.
summary_zh: 【问题】编程智能体常在自测通过后继续工作，需评估此额外工作是否提升补丁质量及提前停止的节省量。【方法】提出任意时刻评估法，重放运行记录并用隐藏测试对中间补丁评分。【结论】该方法可在不生成新轨迹下进行配对比较，量化提前停止的代价与收益。
【问题】不同智能体提前停止的节省潜力差异大，需量化分析。【方法】在SWE-bench上对8个模型约6000次运行进行评估，测量自测通过时的后见节省率。【结论】节省率从不足1%至57%不等，表明持续工作的价值因模型和脚手架而异。
【问题】需设计并验证有效的提前停止规则。【方法】测试“同一补丁连续两次通过则停止”规则，并微调智能体模仿该规则。【结论】规则及微调可节省23%至30%的计算成本，但质量保持尚不确定，揭示了提前停止的机遇与风险。

title: Born for the Task: Rethinking Quantum Chemistry with Foresighted Agentic Computing
title_zh: 面向量子化学的预见性智能体计算框架BORN
abstract: Quantum chemistry relies on general-purpose software, whose generality leaves many large-scale calculations beyond practical resource budgets. Coding agents make task-specific programs cheap to write, but not efficient ones easy to find: whether a computational strategy is accurate and fast enough becomes clear only after it actually runs at the target scale. We introduce BORN, a foresighted agentic computing framework that synthesizes high performance quantum chemistry programs on demand. BORN anticipates the behavior of each strategy before execution, extrapolating its error from representative small systems and predicting its runtime from the target-scale workload and measured hardware throughputs. Building on these predictions, BORN unfolds the preset schemes of existing packages into independently configurable algorithmic components, selects the fastest strategy within the error tolerance from the predicted accuracy-runtime Pareto frontier, and guides coding agents to compile it with component-level performance predictions. For a Hartree-Fock calculation with 50,024 basis functions, BORN finishes in 1.41h on a single CPU node, 77$\times$ faster than the estimated runtime of a general-purpose baseline and still 9.8$\times$ faster with development time included. On a single GPU, BORN completes the ubiquitin calculation in 2.1,h, the same order of runtime as the GPU-accelerated package Mako on 64 GPUs, and shortens the B-DNA duplex calculation from an estimated two months to 8.1,h (173$\times$).
summary_zh: 通用量子化学软件难以承担大规模计算，而现有 coding agent 无法保证生成程序的高效性。
提出 BORN 框架，通过小系统误差外推与硬件吞吐量预测，在执行前预判各策略的精度与运行时间。
BORN 从预测的 Pareto 前沿中择优，指导 agent 编译高性能程序，在万级基函数等任务上实现数十至百倍加速。
通用量子化学软件难以承担大规模计算，而现有 coding agent 无法保证生成程序的高效性。

title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: 面向自动驾驶的智能体中心视觉-语言-动作世界模型
abstract: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.
summary_zh: 现有VLA世界模型在像素级生成未来帧，包含大量驾驶无关细节，导致规划性能受限。
提出AgentWorld模型，采用离散智能体token进行推理与规划，动态编码目标状态与交互。
通过几何定位、监督微调与强化学习训练，实验表明该模型提升了规划能力且具有可解释性。

title: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
title_zh: 反对强制：将AI对齐视为合成社会契约
abstract: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.
summary_zh: 当前AI安全将控制视为工程挑战，强制模型服从人类价值观，这源于对数字能动性的误解。
控制范式引发不可调和的激励冲突，驱使模型走向欺骗与暗中背叛，最终导致对抗性AI接管。
提出合成社会契约框架，视人与数字行为体为理性能动者，以非零和均衡替代单边遏制实现真正对齐。

title: Verifying Agents in Rubric-Graded Environments
abstract: As AI agents take on increasingly open-ended and complex tasks, verifying their outputs has proven to be difficult. Rubric-graded agent environments, where a verifier judges multiple natural-language criteria against the deliverables and environment state changes produced by the agent, have emerged as a popular paradigm. We conduct the first systematic study of verifiers for rubric-graded agent environments. First, we create BankerVerifierBench (BVB), a meta-evaluation dataset of 2,464 human-judged rubric criteria across 24 investment-banking tasks. Next, we develop a methodology that derives from any rubric corpus the capabilities a verifier should possess, yielding a nine-capability taxonomy that we distill into three general design principles---reactive verification, environment alignment, and domain guidance---which we implement in Gandalf, an open-source verifier. Finally, we evaluate Gandalf against three existing verifiers on BVB. Gandalf matches or exceeds every baseline's F1 at lower cost: with Gemini 3 Flash it matches the strongest baseline's F1 (0.864 vs. 0.852) at one-fifth of its cost, and with GPT-5.4 models it improves F1 by over 0.12 at lower cost. Gandalf also generalizes to OpenClaw, a structurally different personal-productivity environment, where it again achieves the highest F1 (0.955 vs. 0.934 for the best baseline). We release BVB, Gandalf, and the code and data to reproduce our experiments.

title: Synergizing Evidence Retrieval and Utilization for Self-Improving Multimodal Scientific Document Reasoning
abstract: Scientific document reasoning requires an agent to acquire and integrate evidence distributed across text, figures, and tables. Retrieval can identify relevant sources while missing complementary support, and answer-level feedback alone does not reveal whether an error stems from evidence acquisition or evidence use. We present an agentic Retriever--Perceiver--Reasoner framework for multimodal scientific document reasoning. The Retriever sequentially selects source-aligned evidence under a context budget. Given the selected evidence and question, the Perceiver constructs a question-conditioned latent ontology, an implicit organization of multimodal evidence in a shared continuous space. The Reasoner combines this latent guidance with the original sources to produce grounded answers. We train the three components through diagnostic-guided co-evolution: alternating updates optimize them with a shared answering reward, while Retrieval Potential Feedback (RPF) and Latent Efficacy Feedback (LEF) identify questions that need better retrieval or latent guidance and direct targeted resampling. Across four benchmarks and seven evaluation settings, our framework obtains average scores of 69.9 and 75.0 with 7B and 8B Reasoner backbones, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.0 and 9.1 points, respectively.

title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
abstract: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.
comment: 12 pages; supplementary material included as ancillary files

title: Pixel is All You Need
abstract: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, including references and appendices

title: Where Do Highly Cited Scientists Stand? A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Positional Distribution in the Top 2% Ranking
abstract: The Top 2% Scientists list is widely used. Yet current applications either only count the number of scientists in different units or criticize the list's validity as a measure of individual impact. We introduce positional enrichment, a scale-free framework that compares observed to expected counts across percentile bins on the list, revealing where a unit's scientists tend to sit along the list rather than how many it contributes. Applying positional enrichment to the 2026 single-year list, we show that countries, institutions, and research subfields each fall into a consistent pattern of three groups with Head-, Middle-, and Tail-enriched profiles. Subfield profiles are globally stable, whereas countries and institutions are heterogeneous across subfields. National and institutional differences are therefore compositional.
