Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforceable control boundary between intent and real-world effect.

title: Feedback-Aware Residual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Timely Communication in Cognitive Radio Networks
abstract: Supporting time-sensitive services in cognitive radio networks requires distributed access strategies that translate shared spectrum opportunities into timely packet delivery. Achieving this objective is challenging because reception conditions are only partially observable to individual transmitters, while dynamic competition and access overhead constrain the service that can be completed within packet deadlines. We formulate a distributed access problem that captures the coupling among interference-dependent reception, queue evolution, and protocol durations. To address this problem, we propose feedback-aware residual multi-agent proximal policy optimization (FAR-MAPPO) under centralized training and decentralized execution. The method constructs channel-specific historical feedback representations that complement instantaneous sensing with evidence from completed access attempts. A residual policy network integrates this experience with current observations and packet urgency to guide local access decisions. Numerical results show improved timely delivery over the baseline methods, particularly under heavy traffic and bursty arrivals with mixed packet deadlines.

title: Revisiting What Makes a Good Context Subset: A Sparse Latent Basis Perspective
abstract: Selecting context subsets is increasingly important in modern LLM inference, yet what makes a subset effective remains unclear. We study this question in the controlled setting of few-shot demonstration selection. We examine a hypothesis that demonstrations should collectively provide task-relevant information needed by a target query. Assuming that the query representation provides a useful proxy for these requirements, we formulate selection as sparse reconstruction and instantiate it with Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style diagnostic procedure. Across seven benchmarks and eight open-weight LLMs, no retrieval objective is universally best. RES outperforms MMR in 34 of 56 model--dataset pairs, with its clearest advantage on sentiment tasks, suggesting that query-conditioned collective reconstruction may capture useful complementarity that pairwise dissimilarity misses. Relevance-based retrieval remains strong on template-heavy reasoning benchmarks, while all retrieval methods underperform zero-shot prediction on average on StrategyQA, where a solution-reconstruction analysis is consistent with the query not exposing the required external knowledge. Target-model hidden states further show that retrieval objectives interact differently with representation spaces: middle-layer representations generally favor similarity retrieval, whereas last-layer representations are often stronger for residual- and diversity-based selection. These findings support a conditional, representation-dependent account of context subset quality rather than a universally superior selector.
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. The format of ACL rolling review

title: Site-Specific Cell Shaping: An Agentic Framework
title_zh: 面向6G小区定制的智能体框架
abstract: An agentic framework is proposed for cell shaping in future sixth-generation (6G) wireless network planning. Cell shaping controls the coverage and interferences of base stations (BSs) through antenna parameters configuration, providing an important means of improving coverage. In contrast to conventional approaches that reply on costly performance evaluations, the proposed framework achieves intelligent and efficient antenna configuration through a perception-reasoning-reflection loop. Specifically, a Configuration Agent combines scene information, evaluation history, and reflection feedback to generate antenna configuration proposals. Then, a ray tracing(RT)-based evaluator assesses these proposals and returns a structured performance summary. Next, a Reflection Agent interprets these results to diagnose site-specific performance deficiencies, recommend feasible configuration adjustments, and accumulate conditional experience. Through this iterative process, the framework accumulates site-specific experience and progressively refines antenna configurations without human-in-the-loop intervention. Simulations in real-world urban scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves lower outage probabilities than the considered benchmark methods, highlighting the effectiveness of agentic reasoning and reflection in translating site-specific performance feedback and accumulated experience into adaptive antenna configuration decisions.
summary_zh: 传统基站天线配置依赖高成本评估，难以高效实现6G网络小区定制化覆盖与干扰控制。
提出基于感知-推理-反思循环的智能体框架，由配置智能体、RT评估器和反思智能体迭代优化天线参数。
无需人工干预即可积累站点经验并持续优化配置，仿真表明其中断概率低于基准方法。

title: Omni-Workspace: Benchmarking Omni-Modal AI Assistants on Multimodal Workspace Tasks
title_zh: Omni-Workspace：多模态工作空间任务的全模态AI助手基准
abstract: Omni-modal agents are expected to move beyond multimodal understanding toward completing complex tasks in realistic multimodal environments. In these settings, information is distributed across heterogeneous files and modalities, with cross-file and cross-modal dependencies requiring agents to continually coordinate perception, reasoning, and tool use as newly gathered evidence informs subsequent actions. However, existing omni-modal benchmarks primarily focus on multimodal perception and understanding, leaving complex task completion through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces underexplored. We introduce Omni-Workspace, a benchmark comprising 380 deep-research-style tasks across four multimodal workspace types and two difficulty levels. These tasks require agents to inspect and process workspace files, retrieve external information when needed, integrate evidence across files and modalities, and produce artifacts satisfying explicit requirements. Evaluating 18 representative models reveals limitations in long-horizon multimodal workspace execution, with the best model scoring only 65.93 on average. Further analysis identifies multimodal context inflation and task-state drift as recurring challenges. Motivated by these findings, we further propose OmniFocus, a lightweight approach combining multimodal working-memory management with explicit task-state tracking to improve performance and efficiency. Omni-Workspace advances the evaluation and development of omni-modal agents toward autonomous completion of complex tasks in multimodal workspaces.
summary_zh: 现有全模态基准侧重感知理解，缺乏对多模态工作空间中复杂任务完成能力的评估。
提出Omni-Workspace基准，含380个任务，要求agent跨文件与模态整合证据并生成产物。
评估18个模型发现最佳均分仅65.93，据此提出OmniFocus方法缓解上下文膨胀与任务状态漂移。

title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
title_zh: LogT：面向视觉搜索的逻辑图像思考
abstract: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\times$ less data and $>120\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.
summary_zh: 现有VLM在结合Zoom-in工具进行视觉搜索时，难以兼顾逻辑推理与工具的准确高效使用。
提出LogT，一种全自动SFT数据引擎，通过强制逻辑链引导推理，生成高质量的结构化工具使用轨迹数据。
基于LogT微调的模型用更少数据和算力超越SOTA，且工具使用更准确高效，推理更具逻辑一致性。

title: What Moves a LoCoMo Score? Memory Context, Answer Prompts and Judges
title_zh: 影响LoCoMo得分的因素：记忆上下文、回答提示与评判器
abstract: LoCoMo is a widely reported benchmark for long-term conversational memory, but published scores mix memory quality with choices of answer prompt, judge and baseline layout that are rarely reported together. We measure how much these choices move a score, and evaluate Becos, a team memory system for coding agents, as a black box under all of them: ten conversations (1,540 questions), two answer models (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini), two answer prompts and three LLM judges, against a whole-conversation baseline rerun under identical conditions. Changing only the judge moves a score by up to 7.2 points and changing only the answer prompt by up to 9.3. A blind human check of 150 answers finds the judges reliable when they agree, and the primary judge's errors on disputed answers working against Becos rather than for it. Becos answers from a context with 90% fewer characters than the whole conversation. Its configuration was developed on LoCoMo itself, so there is no held-out set. With gpt-4o-mini answers it scores clearly higher than the whole conversation (79.7 vs 73.0 with the short prompt, paired 95% interval for the difference +3.8 to +9.5; 88.8 vs 77.5 with a step-by-step prompt). With gpt-4.1-mini answers the two score about the same (83.2 vs 83.1; 92.5 vs 92.1). We release every answer and verdict and the scoring script.
summary_zh: 现有长期对话记忆基准LoCoMo的得分混杂了记忆质量与提示、评判器等选择，缺乏统一报告。
本文在多种回答模型、提示和LLM评判器下评估Becos记忆系统，发现仅更换评判器或提示可使得分波动达7.2和9.3分。
Becos用不到10%的上下文字符，在gpt-4o-mini下显著优于全对话基线，在gpt-4.1-mini下两者持平。
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Answers, judge verdicts, human-check grades and scoring script: https://github.com/becos-ai/locomo-results

title: Generalization Testing of Grid Foundation Models for Power Flow and Optimal Power Flow
title_zh: 电网基础模型在潮流与最优潮流中的泛化测试
abstract: There is growing interest in foundation models (FMs) for power grids, particularly for power flow and optimal power flow. Their usefulness depends on generalization accuracy, which existing works test on their own benchmarks. We propose a three-axis framework to test their generalization limits: changed admittance matrices of training grids, load levels, and unseen grids. We test GENCO, LUMINA and GridSFM against the DC baseline, alongside their reported limitations, and discuss theoretical reasons for their failures. Experiments reveal that adding a line degrades all FMs more than removing one, and longer lines eventually make LUMINA and fine-tuned GENCO worse than DC. All three degrade beyond their training load range, where the loading-voltage curve steepens. On unseen grids, LUMINA degrades sharply even inside its training range, and GridSFM fails on the grid farthest from it. Thus, beyond training conditions, FMs behave more like meta-models requiring test-time fine-tuning data and compute.
summary_zh: 现有电网基础模型泛化精度缺乏统一评测，提出三轴框架测试其在导纳矩阵、负荷水平及未见电网上的泛化极限。
实验表明，增加线路比移除线路更易导致模型退化，长线路使LUMINA等劣于DC基准；超出训练负荷范围后模型均退化。
在未见电网上模型泛化急剧下降，表明超出训练条件时基础模型更似需测试时微调的元模型。

title: Distilling Safety Filters for Filter-free Multi-agent RL
title_zh: 面向无滤波器多智能体强化学习的安全滤波器蒸馏
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can teach robot teams to navigate shared spaces, but trial and error causes collisions that real robots cannot afford. Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters prevent these collisions by correcting unsafe actions, yet in a team the filter becomes a centralized optimization whose number of constraints grows quadratically with the team size. We propose an approach that builds the filter's safety into the RL policy and examine how such a system behaves during filter-free deployment. However, the filter that keeps training safe also hides what the policy must learn: it masks the cost of unsafe actions, which actor-critic methods then overvalue, and it keeps near-collision states out of the training data. Our approach therefore learns only from executed safe actions with implicit Q-learning and distills the filter into the policy at synthetic near-collision states. We prove that filter distillation loss bounds the policy's constraint violation and hence how far agents can cross their safety margin, so errors never accumulate. When distillation states cover deployed states, the loss also bounds the collision probability at every step. Without a filter and acting only on local observations, our policies have no collisions in 1,800 test episodes with multiple agents. A policy trained with three agents transfers zero-shot to teams of twenty at constant per-agent computation and stays collision-free with up to eight agents. We test our policies on Crazyflie quadrotors with up to five flying at the same time.
summary_zh: 多智能体RL中CBF安全滤波器约束随团队规模二次增长，导致计算开销大。
将安全滤波器蒸馏进RL策略，用隐式Q学习仅从安全动作学习，并在合成近碰撞状态蒸馏。
所提策略无需滤波器即可部署，多智能体零碰撞；且3智能体策略零样本迁移至20智能体仍保持无碰撞。

title: Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: 视觉语言模型真的看路了吗？自动驾驶的诊断评估
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \& Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.
summary_zh: VLM在自动驾驶问答基准上高准确率未必反映视觉推理能力，需诊断其是否依赖语言先验等偏差。
提出诊断评估框架，含恶劣天气与路口任务，通过四项协议系统探测VLM的视觉依据与鲁棒性。
发现模型存在肯定偏差且无视视觉输入仍做决策，表明当前VLM缺乏安全关键视觉依据。

title: LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models
title_zh: 药物知识文献中疗效与安全限制的不对称性
abstract: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL.
summary_zh: 药物禁忌症对安全至关重要，但文献记录远少于适应症，存在疗效与安全限制的文档不对称（LABEL）。
LLM镜像了此不对称性：随模型规模扩大，适应症准确率提升，但禁忌症准确率停滞于随机猜测水平。
RAG检索或路由至FDA标签可显著提升安全事实准确率，表明模型失败源于语料缺失而非推理缺陷，临床AI应依赖官方标签。
comment: 27 pages (9 main + supplementary material), 8 figures, 7 tables

title: From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems
title_zh: 从传感器到硅片：因果跨层自愈边缘AI
abstract: The migration of artificial intelligence from centralized cloud infrastructure to resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices reduces communication latency and improves data locality, but it also tightly couples sensing quality, inference behavior, microarchitectural activity, hardware reliability, security, and energy management within the same physical node. Existing edge-intelligence solutions predominantly address these dimensions in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether an observed degradation originates from sensor malfunction, data-distribution shift, malicious execution, hardware faults, or resource and thermal stress. This paper presents a causal cross-layer self-healing Edge-AI framework that continuously observes synchronized telemetry spanning sensor health, inference uncertainty, processor hardware-performance counters, accelerator and memory activity, power and thermal state, and communication conditions. A temporally informed causal reasoning engine estimates the most probable origin of abnormal behavior and quantifies diagnostic uncertainty, including under concurrent perturbations.
summary_zh: 边缘AI将计算下放至IoT节点，导致传感、推理、硬件与能耗等多维度紧密耦合，现有方案孤立处理难以定位异常根源。
提出因果跨层自愈边缘AI框架，持续观测涵盖传感器健康、推理不确定性、硬件计数器及功耗热状态等多层同步遥测数据。
引入时序因果推理引擎，估计异常行为的最可能起源并量化诊断不确定性，有效应对并发扰动下的性能退化问题。

title: FundingClaw: Automated Grant Proposal Writing Agents System
title_zh: FundingClaw：自动化的基金申请书撰写智能体系统
abstract: Grant proposal writing remains a manual, labor-intensive bottleneck: proposals must satisfy rigid, agency-specific templates, and the same intellectual content must be repeatedly re-encoded into incompatible formats across funding organizations. We introduce FundingClaw, a multi-agent framework built on template-driven skill selection, where a Template Parser ingests any agency's specification and selects the appropriate writing skills for each stage, so that one research brief can produce compliant proposals for NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC without modifying generation logic. A blueprint-skeleton strategy drafts a structured outline before any prose is written, mitigating the semantic drift that plagues long-form generation. Three sequential stages produce the rationale, research content, and research foundation sections, with multi-source verification of the PI's record and optional PDF-grounded extraction of representative works. Optional human feedback checkpoints and a closed-loop self-review complete the pipeline. Evaluated on ten research topics with an eight-dimension rubric, FundingClaw outperforms the baseline, narrowing the gap with human level for laborious funding proposal. The code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 基金申请书撰写需满足不同机构模板，重复劳动多。提出FundingClaw多智能体框架，基于模板驱动技能选择，一份研究简报可生成多机构合规申请书。
长文本生成易语义漂移。采用蓝图-骨架策略先生成结构大纲再写正文，经三阶段生成核心内容，并结合多源验证与闭环自审确保质量。
在10个研究主题及8维标准下评估，FundingClaw优于基线，显著缩小了与人类撰写繁琐基金申请书的差距。

title: When the Mythical Man-Month Meets Agentic Web Systems: Structured Coordination for Scalable Development
title_zh: 神话人月遇上智能体Web系统：可扩展开发的结构化协调
abstract: As agentic systems are increasingly deployed to support complex Web tasks, multi-agent architectures offer greater parallelism, specialization, and task coverage. However, increasing the number of agents does not necessarily improve system performance, as communication, synchronization, redundant work, and coordination overhead may offset the benefits of additional agents. This presents a fundamental scaling challenge for agentic Web systems: how can agent populations be organized to balance task performance and coordination costs? To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the relationship between agent population size, per-agent token consumption, and coordination overhead in collaborative agentic systems. Experiments on complex Web-oriented software development tasks reveal a non-linear scaling pattern: per-agent token consumption initially decreases as the agent population grows, but eventually exhibits diminishing returns. Motivated by these findings, we introduce the Surgical Team Model (STM), a structured coordination framework that organizes agents through role specialization, constrained inter-agent communication, and coordinator-mediated task aggregation. Experiments on full-stack Web application development tasks show that STM achieves competitive task completion quality and comparable token consumption relative to representative baselines, while incurring higher execution latency.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统增加代理数会带来通信与协调开销，引发智能体Web系统的基础扩展挑战。
实验揭示代理规模与单代理token消耗呈非线性关系，初期递减但最终收益递减。
提出外科团队模型(STM)，通过角色专化与受限通信实现结构化协调，任务质量具竞争力但延迟较高。

title: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
title_zh: SuperGlance：基于视觉语言模型的一瞥式自动驾驶
abstract: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.
summary_zh: 现有VLA模型逐步解码规划耗时过长，而快速System 1常置于VLM外丧失其能力，需兼顾速度与视觉理解。
提出SuperGlance，利用VLM读取场景后的隐藏状态，通过线性头对固定候选轨迹打分，将其转为编码器式策略，离线计算奖励并优化。
单次前向传播即可实现规划与视觉问答，耗时84ms，比Qwen-Drive快6倍且性能相当，计入GPU延迟后优势更显著。
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://guobapei.github.io/SuperGlance/ ; code: https://github.com/GuobaPei/SuperGlance

title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ICC

title: A Nonlinear Abstract Domain for Bayesian Neural Networks
title_zh: 贝叶斯神经网络的非线性抽象域
abstract: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) explicitly model epistemic uncertainty by leveraging probability distributions over network parameters, making them better suited for risk-aware decision-making. Yet soundly propagating uncertainty through the network and capturing the entire output distribution to support predictive uncertainty quantification remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches are either sampling-based, providing no formal guarantees, or propagate only selected statistical properties, such as expectations and entropy, limiting their applicability to general probabilistic queries. To address these challenges, we present the first nonlinear abstract domain for soundly approximating complete probability distributions of BNNs. The abstract domain builds upon a novel marginal collecting concrete semantics that soundly abstracts the classical joint-measure semantics. It combines support partitioning with exponential-affine bounds to represent probability measures, capturing both discrete and continuous components of mixed distributions as well as nonlinear density shapes over bounded and unbounded supports. We develop sound abstract transformers that can efficiently handle high-dimensional affine transformations and nonlinear ReLU activations, while remaining highly parallelizable. We further extend the framework beyond BNNs to support bounded-loop probabilistic programs with Bayesian inference to demonstrate its generality. We implement the resulting abstract interpreter as a GPU-accelerated analyzer. Experimental results show that the framework significantly improves precision over existing probabilistic reasoning approaches while soundly capturing the complete output distribution, demonstrating strong efficiency and scalability.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯神经网络需量化预测不确定性，但现有采样法无形式化保证，统计属性传播法难以支持一般概率查询。
提出首个非线性抽象域，基于边缘收集具体语义与指数仿射界，可靠逼近BNN的完整概率分布。
实现GPU加速分析器，精度显著优于现有方法，且可扩展至带贝叶斯推断的有界循环概率程序。

title: Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?
title_zh: 超越基础MCP：决策模型与代码模式让工具调用更廉价高效
abstract: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways manage tool catalogs for language model agents using two primary paradigms: code mode where agents write scripts against tool stubs and decision layers which are cheap routers that preselect tool subsets. Using a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools, and three open-weight agents including Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, we present a preregistered evaluation on a sealed test split to determine when each approach succeeds. Code mode substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70 to 90 percent while significantly boosting utility. Declaring return-shape hints in code mode stubs is a first-order variable, swinging success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, an effect larger than adding a router. The central hypothesis that a decision layer in front of code mode beats code mode alone is not confirmed, showing minor, statistically non-significant improvements for weaker agents and a slight cost for the strongest. We publicly release our harness, a finetuned 4B tool selection model, and all evaluation traces to support robust community experimentation on local AI privacy and agent architectures.
summary_zh: LLM代理调用大量工具时面临高token消耗与低效问题，引入代码模式与决策层路由两种范式进行对比评估。
代码模式让代理编写脚本调用工具，相比基础MCP大幅削减70-90%的token用量并显著提升效用；在存根中声明返回形状提示对低性能代理影响极大。
决策层加代码模式的组合并未显著优于单用代码模式；开源了测试框架、4B工具选择模型及评估轨迹以支持社区研究。
comment: 16 pages, 11 tables. Code, harness, and models available at this http URL https://github.com/abhishek085/mcp-decision-layer

title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
title_zh: 基于智能体引导的过程验证数学自我纠正方法
abstract: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and completeness when key claims provide sufficient coverage and local verification is reliable, provided that all key claims pass verification. The implementation compresses long working contexts and reuses successful tool results within each problem. We evaluate AGPV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with four models from DeepSeek, Qwen, and GPT. AGPV achieves an average accuracy of 63.8%, outperforming the strongest among the representative baselines evaluated (50.3%) by 13.5 percentage points, with higher repair coverage than the programmatic-verification baselines.
summary_zh: 现有LLM数学推理反思难精确定位错误，结果验证易遗漏必要分支，导致错误传播。
提出AGPV方法：将解法分解为关键声明序列并逐一验证，首错即停，由诊断智能体指导纠正智能体从该点重推导。
理论证明AGPV可保证解的正确性与完备性；实验显示其平均准确率达63.8%，显著优于基线。
现有LLM数学推理反思难精确定位错误，结果验证易遗漏必要分支，导致错误传播。

title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
title_zh: 编码定理演进关系引导AI生成数学猜想
abstract: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. Ablations suggest a benefit from constructing and using a TEG even when the available papers are fixed.
summary_zh: 数学猜想生成缺乏评判标准，比证明已有猜想更难且研究较少。
提出定理演进图（TEG）编码定理间修改假设、强化结论等关系，作为LLM agent的在线搜索方法。
LLM与专家评估显示，TEG生成的猜想更具意义与洞察力；消融实验证实构建TEG本身有益。

title: Can Agentic LLMs Write Task-Based Parallel Code? A Study of OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU and TTG
title_zh: 智能体LLM能否编写基于任务的并行代码？
abstract: Task-based programming offers more expressive power than loop-level parallelism, but the runtimes providing it differ widely in API style, maturity, and the amount of public code to learn from. This paper asks how well LLM agents write C++ for four of them: OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG. Instead of single one-shot prompts, we use an agentic workflow in which the model edits files, compiles, and runs its kernels until it reproduces a reference output. Five locally hosted open-weight LLM implement seven HPC kernels, including matrix multiplication, Cholesky and LU factorization, in all four frameworks and a serial baseline to verify their understanding of the problem in general. Every kernel is evaluated independently for correctness at each concurrency level, strong scaling, and peak memory. Model capability dominates the outcome: three models produce correct, genuinely task-parallel kernels in 57-82% of the cases, while two models rarely compile their own code and almost never succeed. For the capable models, OpenMP Tasking and HPX are handled most reliably, StarPU is close behind, and TTG trails. The best generated GEMM and factorization kernels match or exceed the multithreaded OpenBLAS/LAPACK reference. However, correctness overstates parallel quality: several "parallel" kernels contain no parallelism at all; and serialized task graphs and unsuitable task granularity remain common.
summary_zh: 基于任务的并行运行时API差异大且学习资源少，研究LLM智能体为其编写C++代码的能力。
采用智能体工作流让5个开源LLM为4种框架实现7个HPC内核，评估其正确性、扩展性与内存。
模型能力决定成败：强模型超半数生成正确并行代码，部分性能超参考库，但常存在伪并行或任务粒度不当问题。

title: When the Spec Sheet Lies: Injection Attacks on LLM-Generated Compliance Artifacts
title_zh: LLM生成合规文档的注入攻击研究
abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become used more commonly across a variety of fields, a growing body of research has highlighted particular concerns surrounding model security. Notably, prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions are inserted into prompts, are particularly simple to implement yet capable of inducing devastating effects on the fidelity of model outputs. While there is substantial research surrounding attack models and their effects on chat-based models, browser add-ons, and coding agents, the impact of these same attacks on industrial LLM-generated artifacts has been left largely unexplored. As LLM-enabled agents are increasingly used to skim and generate industrial documents such as Safety Data Sheets (SDS), Quality Control (QC) documents, and Digital Product Passports (DPP), it remains unclear how adversaries may influence these systems to manipulate generated compliance artifacts. This work aims to address this core inquiry by examining how a variety of prompt injection attacks can compromise LLMs with industrial document generation tasks. The study finds that injection attack success varies significantly across different models. Active falsification injections are most successful under all scenarios, while models tend to be most robust against passively injected override requests.
summary_zh: 工业界使用LLM生成合规文档时，易受提示注入攻击影响，但该风险尚未被充分探索。
研究检验了多种提示注入攻击对执行工业文档生成任务的LLM的破坏方式与效果。
发现攻击成功率因模型而异：主动伪造注入最易成功，模型对被动覆盖请求最具鲁棒性。

title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
title_zh: 异构团队组合多智能体强化学习的假设/保证契约
abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. We then propose an iterative algorithm for task assignment and MARL that alternates between assigning contracts representing subtasks to individual agents, training the assigned agents to satisfy their contracts, and assessing their resulting capabilities to inform the next round of task assignments until the team's success probability meets the desired threshold. Our experimental results demonstrate the versatility of contracts in enabling agent substitution and contract reuse. Across three benchmarks with five seeds each, IHA-MARL achieves observed $100\%$ final evaluation success. In CPU timing pilots, comparable baselines required approximately $7$--$11\times$ more training-loop time.
summary_zh: 异构MARL需协同完成团队任务并利用多样能力，为此引入AGC-MAS契约与IHA-MARL算法。
AGC-MAS将团队任务分解为子任务契约，通过自动机同步，支持异构智能体替换与契约复用。
IHA-MARL迭代执行契约分配、训练与能力评估，在三个基准测试中实现100%最终成功率。

title: HorizANN: Elastically Scaling Vector Search with Ghost Edges
title_zh: HorizANN：基于幽灵边的弹性可扩展向量搜索
abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is fundamental to modern data-intensive AI applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, recommendation systems, and semantic search. Among existing indexing methods, graph-based indexes emerge as the state of the art due to their superior recall-throughput tradeoffs. Scaling these indexes to multiple machines requires partitioning the data and building indexes on each. However, when new machines are added or removed, the data must be repartitioned and the indexes reconstructed from scratch, making horizontal scaling costly at billion scale. In this work, we present HorizANN, a distributed graph-based ANNS system that scales horizontally without requiring full index reconstruction. To achieve this, we introduce ghost edges, a mechanism for preserving cross-partition connectivity as partition boundaries change during repartitioning. By reusing the structural information that would otherwise be discarded during repartitioning, HorizANN avoids costly full index reconstruction. As the index grows from 100M vectors on one worker to 1B vectors on ten workers, HorizANN inserts each 100M vectors within 2.5 hours and sustains 3.4--3.5K queries per second at 0.998 Recall@10.
summary_zh: 图索引在分布式ANNS扩展时，增删节点需重分区并从头重建索引，成本高昂。
提出HorizANN系统，引入幽灵边机制，在重分区时保留跨分区连接并复用结构信息。
无需全量重建索引，扩展至十节点十亿向量时，插入耗时短且维持高召回与高吞吐。

title: Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings
title_zh: 基于帕累托排序的多验证器策略优化
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. Pareto dominance identifies responses that satisfy additional requirements without losing any already satisfied, while leaving responses with conflicting outcomes incomparable. POLPO extends the listwise likelihood underlying Direct Preference Optimization by maximizing the total probability of all complete rankings consistent with these partial orders. This objective provides supervision from verified improvements even before complete solutions are available, without requiring a prescribed ordering of incomparable responses. Experiments on code generation and instruction following demonstrate improved learning efficiency and higher rates of complete requirement satisfaction compared with scalar-reward training. These results support partial-order likelihood as an effective approach to learning from multiple verifiers.
summary_zh: 多验证器评估LLM响应时，反馈常被聚合成标量奖励，丢弃部分成功细节并强加不可比响应间的排序。
提出POLPO方法，利用帕累托支配建立偏序，最大化与其一致的全排序概率，避免构造聚合奖励。
实验表明，偏序似然能从验证改进中提供监督，相比标量奖励训练提升了学习效率与完全满足率。

title: Run, Read Back, Refine: Observation Fidelity in Execution-Grounded EDA Agents
title_zh: 执行驱动的EDA智能体：观察保真度与闭环优化
abstract: Design engineers lose the most time orchestrating flows and patching the gaps where closed EDA tools refuse to interoperate. We present an execution-grounded LLM agent for PyAether, SKILL, and Tcl that closes a generate-execute-refine loop over unified MCP tools (API retrieval, documentation, sandbox execution) and is already deployed in production EDA flows, with a grounding-gap framework positing that EDA-scripting correctness is bottlenecked by observation fidelity at the L4 (situated) layer, which model scale alone cannot reach. On EDA-Scripting-Bench (449 tasks, three languages, four commercial runtimes), the system reaches 76.5% pooled Pass@1 versus 19.7% (pure LLM): the system-level observation axis spans 56.8 percentage points with the model fixed, exceeding the 23.3-percentage-point backbone range with the harness fixed---two axes answering different questions; observation is an under-invested axis whose returns are measurable and graded.
summary_zh: EDA工具互操作性差导致工程师耗时，本文提出基于LLM的执行驱动智能体，通过统一MCP工具实现生成-执行-优化的闭环。
提出grounding-gap框架，指出EDA脚本正确性受限于L4层的观察保真度，仅靠扩大模型规模无法突破该瓶颈。
在449项任务测试中，系统Pass@1达76.5%（纯LLM为19.7%），证明提升观察保真度比扩大模型规模收益更显著。
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Manuscript prepared for the DAC 2027 Research Track (IEEE conference format)

title: Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining
title_zh: 预训练中推理数据的作用研究
abstract: Reasoning data expose models to multi-step reasoning, but reasoning traces may cover only a subset of the available facts. How should pretraining balance atomic facts with reasoning traces? We study this question by constructing a setting in which every fact provides an atomic training signal, while only a subset appears in reasoning supervision, enabling us to measure generalization to transitions observed atomically but never used in training traces. For a linear transformer, we derive the weight assigned to atomic training signals that minimizes held-transition squared error and show that its leading-order optimum increases with reasoning-chain length and decreases with the fraction of facts held out from reasoning traces. These trends persist in a full transformer layer with an MLP, softmax attention, and cross-entropy loss. We further validate the role of reasoning complexity and data coverage in two natural-language settings: controlled multi-hop reasoning and mathematical pretraining. Together, our results provide a principled view of how reasoning-chain structure and data coverage should shape the allocation of training data during pretraining.
summary_zh: 预训练需平衡原子事实与推理轨迹，但推理轨迹仅覆盖部分事实，影响模型泛化。
针对线性Transformer推导最优权重，发现其对原子事实的分配随推理链长度增加，随未覆盖事实比例减少。
在含MLP的完整Transformer及自然语言实验中验证上述趋势，为预训练数据分配提供理论指导。

title: B2G-Agent: An LLM-Based Multi-Agent Tool for End-to-End Building-Grid Interactions
title_zh: B2G-Agent：基于LLM的建筑-电网端到端交互多智能体工具
abstract: Buildings are major electricity consumers and can interact with distribution network dispatch through flexible power scheduling. These interactions require distribution network operators (DNOs) and building energy managers (BEMs) to reconcile their operational constraints and perform complex cross-field computations. The lack of cross-domain expertise and unified computational workflows could lead to inefficient or physically infeasible interactions. To address this bottleneck, we develop an end-to-end large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent tool, B2G-Agent, that bridges DNOs and BEMs. The tool deploys three collaborative agents: a Translator for bidirectional cross-domain semantic mapping via hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); an Actor for automated configuration and execution of joint simulation and optimization through directed acyclic graphs; and a Reviewer for memory-augmented reflective failure diagnosis. This workflow abstracts away cross-field modeling complexities and enables both sides to focus on high-level operational decisions. Comprehensive evaluations across 200 synthesized tasks show that B2G-Agent improves the interaction quality score from 66.71 to 85.57 and increases the task success rate from 38.0% to 69.0% over the baseline while satisfying operational constraints. The open-source tool and interface are available at https://github.com/hkuedl/B2G-Agent.
summary_zh: 建筑与电网交互需跨领域计算，缺乏统一工作流易导致低效或不可行。本文提出B2G-Agent以桥接双方。
该工具部署三个协作智能体：基于混合RAG的Translator实现语义映射，Actor执行联合仿真与优化，Reviewer进行反思式故障诊断。
在200个任务评估中，B2G-Agent将交互质量分从66.71提至85.57，任务成功率从38.0%升至69.0%。

title: Early Spectroscopy of the Type II SN 2024phv Suggests Short-Lived Circumstellar Interaction
title_zh: II型超新星2024phv早期光谱揭示短暂星周物质相互作用
abstract: We present the high-cadence light curve and rapid spectroscopy of the Type II SN 2024phv, discovered just 16.8 hours after the estimated explosion time. The early light curve exhibits a rapid 2 mag rise over the first day of observation, and spectra at 1.7 and 2.6 days reveal weak, narrow emission lines, suggesting moderate interaction with circumstellar material during the first few days after explosion. Models of shock-cooling emission provide a reasonable fit to the light curve after day 2, implying minimal interaction at later epochs, and yield a best-fit progenitor radius of $R=390\pm90\,R_{\odot}$. We also compare our earliest spectra with radiation hydrodynamical models of exploding red supergiants to measure circumstellar densities of ${\sim}10^{-12}$ g cm$^{-3}$ within a few stellar radii of the progenitor, followed by a sharp dropoff in the density profile. This rapidly decreasing profile leads us to conclude that the progenitor of SN 2024phv had an extended atmosphere and/or closely confined circumstellar material, likely from rapidly increasing or eruptive mass loss prior to explosion. In the context of other supernovae discovered at similarly early phases, SN 2024phv points to a diversity in the mass-loss rates of red supergiant stars in their final years.
summary_zh: 【问题】超新星爆发早期星周物质相互作用特征不明；【方法】对爆发后16.8小时发现的II型超新星2024phv进行高频光变与快速光谱观测；【结论】首日快速增亮且早期存在弱窄发射线，表明初期存在中等强度星周物质相互作用。
【问题】如何确定前身星参数及星周物质密度分布；【方法】利用激波冷却辐射模型拟合光变曲线，结合辐射流体动力学模型分析早期光谱；【结论】测得前身星半径约390太阳半径，星周密度在几倍恒星半径内约10^-12 g cm^-3且随后急剧下降。
【问题】红超巨星临终前质量损失率是否一致；【方法】结合星周密度急剧下降的特征与同类早期超新星观测进行对比；【结论】前身星具有延伸大气或紧邻星周物质，源于爆发前急剧增加的质量损失，揭示了红超巨星最后几年质量损失率的多样性。

title: MemoryLane: Supporting Reminiscence Conversations Between Older Adults with Mild Dementia and Lay Caregivers Using a Simulated AI Agent
title_zh: MemoryLane：用AI代理支持轻度痴呆患者与护理者的回忆对话
abstract: Reminiscence Therapy (RT) is a non-pharmacological intervention that invites patients to discuss and review past life experiences and memories to improve their emotional and mental well-being. In practice, many reminiscence conversations are led by lay caregivers, such as spouses and adult children. While traditional RT often relies on personal photographs, curating them can be tedious and difficult. In addition, caregivers who lack shared life experiences with the patient may struggle to facilitate engaging reminiscence conversations. This paper presents MemoryLane, an AI-integrated tool that helps lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations without curated photographs. MemoryLane supports a triadic conversation among the patient, the caregiver, and a simulated AI agent that acts as the patient's peer. A shared interface shows the agent and AI-generated images of the memories being discussed, while a private smartphone interface lets the caregiver control the behavior of the simulated AI agent and moderate the AI-generated images. A preliminary focus group study with five dementia-care stakeholders suggested the value of MemoryLane's AI agent as a peer companion and of AI-generated images, as well as the feasibility of having caregivers moderate images and control the AI agent.
summary_zh: 传统回忆疗法依赖照片且缺乏共同经历的护理者难以引导对话，需新辅助工具。
提出MemoryLane工具，引入模拟AI代理作为患者同伴，并用AI生成图像替代照片。
初步研究表明，AI代理作为同伴和AI生成图像具有价值，护理者调控代理与图像可行。

title: Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression
title_zh: 角色分离扩散Transformer与确定性流形压缩
abstract: We present Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers (RoSeDiT), a new diffusion transformer architecture that isolates the global rule from the image tokens. RoSeViT showed in visual reasoning that a vanilla ViT spreads a shared rule over all $L$ tokens at an entropy of order $Ld$, whereas an enforced controller route reduces it to order $d$. In class-conditional DiT and SiT, the class and the noise level are explicitly conditioned by adaLN, so a RoSeViT-style controller channel on the ViT side is insufficient to establish the full role separation. By introducing the adaLN listening mechanism, which makes adaLN compute under the controller's command, RoSeDiT brings the entropy theorem and role separation into the latent diffusion domain. Under the same SiT training and evaluation protocol at the same level of parameter count, RoSeDiT surpasses SiT at all four model scales at 400K steps, and RoSeDiT-L/2 even surpasses SiT-XL/2's 17.2 FID with 15.34 and 32% fewer parameters. RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT-XL/2's 7M-step FID of 8.3 at 1.4M steps with 7.98, using one-fifth as many training steps. We further observe that models with the same denoising loss can have a large FID gap, which indicates a misalignment between the denoising objective and the image manifold. We formalize this phenomenon into Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression (DSMC), a two-stage training schedule with which RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT + REPA's 4M-step FID of 5.9 at 2.4M steps with 5.84.
summary_zh: 视觉推理中ViT将全局规则分散至所有token导致高熵，需通过控制器路由降低熵并实现角色分离。
引入adaLN监听机制使adaLN受控制器指令计算，将角色分离引入潜扩散域，构建RoSeDiT架构。
RoSeDiT在同等参数下全面超越SiT；针对去噪目标与图像流形不对齐提出DSMC训练策略，进一步刷新FID指标。
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Github Repo: https://github.com/lz7fd/RoSeDiT

title: Agent-ZTA: A chain-Aware Zero Trust Model for Bidirectional Security-State Propagation and Runtime Containment in Multi-Agent Delegation
title_zh: 多智能体委托的链感知零信任模型Agent-ZTA
abstract: Multi-agent systems increasingly delegate tasks and permissions across chains of autonomous agents that invoke protected tools. Although agent identities and delegated credentials may remain valid throughout a workflow, the security condition of any agent along the chain can deteriorate during runtime execution-either through upstream compromise or downstream ingestion of untrusted inputs. Authorization models based solely on the immediate caller and its static delegated scope fail to account for these mid-execution state changes. This paper develops Agent-ZTA, a chain-aware Zero Trust authorization and containment model that links runtime security-state changes across multi-agent delegation graphs. The model distinguishes an agent's path-specific delegated authority bound from the effective permissions currently exercisable under trusted policy. It defines an architecture featuring independently enforced policy decisions, authenticated delegation provenance, a dynamic chain-state view, and explicit fail-safe handling of missing or stale authorization signals. Furthermore, Agent-ZTA defines bidirectional security state propagation, allowing downstream security events to affect relevant upstream workflow states, and specifies adaptive branch-scoped containment through restricted permissions and a sandbox ("jail") execution mode where an isolation boundary is available. The deterministic decision procedure, five stated security properties, and worked authorization traces show how accepted security-state changes constrain affected operations while preserving original delegation bounds and separating unrelated workflow branches under the defined policies. Finally, the paper states its trust assumptions and the exact scope of its security properties.
summary_zh: 多智能体委托链中智能体运行时安全状态可能恶化，仅依赖直接调用方与静态授权的模型无法应对此问题。
提出Agent-ZTA模型，通过双向安全状态传播与自适应沙箱隔离，实现链感知的零信任授权与运行时遏制。
证明该模型在约束受影响操作的同时保留原始委托边界，并隔离无关工作流分支，明确了安全属性范围。

title: GPBam: A Retrieval-Aware German Public Law Exam Benchmark
title_zh: GPBam：面向检索的德国公法考试基准
abstract: Legal reasoning in civil-law systems is not rule-lookup: the German state examination asks for a structured opinion (Gutachten) that names the governing norms, applies them to the facts, and argues to a conclusion. We introduce GPBam (German Public Law Bar-style Exam), 81 public-law examination cases with reference solutions, paired with a recitation task over 200 statutory provisions. Drawn from state examination preparation, the cases are broad and rarely repeat, and are not publicly available - we find no evidence of exact-solution memorisation in the models we evaluate, and keeping them private limits contamination. Because each reference solution's cited norms form a retrieval gold set over the very instances the essays are graded on, GPBam scores retrieval and long-form generation jointly, which makes it a benchmark for legal retrieval as well as for legal writing and lets us ask how much retrieval quality a legal opinion actually needs. Across 32 open-weight and proprietary models evaluated without retrieval, scores span 4.81-76.42 out of 100. Supplying the law helps modestly: across seven models and eight retrieval configurations, retrieval performance varies nearly threefold and buys at most 4.1 essay points, and nothing significant for three of the seven, while an oracle with 91% gold-norm recall improves scores by 2-6 points. Essay quality strongly tracks prior knowledge: verbatim statute recall, measured in a separate task, correlates at $ρ= 0.92$ over 32 models.
summary_zh: 现有法律基准忽视检索与长文本生成的联合评估，无法衡量法律意见对检索质量的依赖。
构建GPBam基准，包含81个公法案例及参考答案，利用引用法条作为检索金标集，联合评估检索与写作。
实验表明提供法律检索对写作提升有限，而文章质量与先验知识（法条逐字回忆）高度相关。
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the 39th International Conference on Legal Knowledge and Information Systems (JURIX 2026). 43 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables

title: NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for Multi-Head Latent Attention
title_zh: NVFP4-MLA：多头潜在注意力的统一FP4 KV缓存与注意力计算
abstract: Long-context reasoning and agentic workloads make key-value (KV) cache capacity and attention computation the dominant costs of serving frontier large language models. We present NVFP4-MLA, the first design to push both KV-cache storage and attention computation of multi-head latent attention (MLA) to FP4. NVFP4-MLA co-designs the quantization algorithm with the attention kernel and the cache system. Selective residual compensation preserves model accuracy by adding NVFP4 residuals only to the quantization-sensitive channels. Two-dimensional quantization blocks make the shared latent cache compatible with the different reduction directions of the two attention batched matrix multiplications (BMMs), removing requantization between them. On DeepSeek-R1 and Kimi-K3, NVFP4-MLA matches BF16 MLA average accuracy across nine benchmarks while compressing the MLA KV cache by 3.20x and 3.05x relative to BF16 MLA. On NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, NVFP4-MLA speeds up the attention kernel over FP8 MLA by up to 2.82x on DeepSeek-R1 and 2.71x on Kimi-K3, and lowers p90 time to first token in agentic multi-turn serving by up to 3.5x and 2.1x, respectively. In disaggregated DeepSeek-R1 serving, it also raises per-GPU throughput by up to 2.30x.
summary_zh: 长上下文与Agent负载使KV缓存和注意力计算成为LLM服务瓶颈，需将MLA的两者均推至FP4精度。
提出NVFP4-MLA，协同设计量化算法、注意力内核与缓存系统：选择性残差补偿保精度，二维量化块消除BMM间重量化。
在DeepSeek-R1等模型上，精度匹敌BF16，KV缓存压缩超3倍；在Rubin GPU上注意力内核较FP8加速近2.8倍，显著提升吞吐。

title: Context Matters: Improving LLM-Based Code Summarization with Hierarchical Information
title_zh: 利用层级信息改进基于LLM的代码摘要
abstract: Source code documentation plays an important role in software quality activities, such as code review, program comprehension, maintenance, and bug fixing. However, it is often fragmented across individual code elements and focuses on local implementation details, providing little information about their surrounding context. This limits both developers' understanding of software systems and the effectiveness of Large Language Models (LLMs), whose reasoning is constrained by finite context windows. Enriching documentation with hierarchical context has the potential to improve software comprehension and support downstream, quality-related tasks for both developers and LLM-based tools. In this paper, we present an in silico study that showcases the impact of augmenting context on the generation of code-level documentation, using a variety of LLMs. By varying the function, class, and module hierarchy visible to the LLMs, we assess whether this variation produces a significant difference in the resulting code documentation compared with the existing documentation, which serves as a proxy for developer intent. Our results show that Documentation-Aware prompts with class or module-level context consistently yield summaries that are closest to the original documentation. Adding surrounding documentation yields statistically significant improvements over the baseline across models, with effect sizes ranging from negligible (DeepSeek) through weak (GPT-4o-mini) to medium (Gemini). We restrict the study to this immediate hierarchical context; call-graph traversal and cross-module dependency context fall outside our scope and are left to future work. These findings provide a clear path to improve automated documentation tools and enhance LLMs' ability to reason about codebases for downstream tasks, such as code retrieval.
summary_zh: 现有代码文档缺乏上下文，限制了开发者理解与LLM推理能力。
向LLM输入不同层级的代码上下文，对比生成文档与原本文档的差异。
加入类或模块级上下文可显著提升摘要质量，不同模型改善效果从微弱到中等不等。
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Accepted and presented at the Brazilian Symposium on Software Quality (SBQS 2026), Technical Track. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.31046290.v2

title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
title_zh: SpecRelay：边缘云推测解码中的往返延迟分摊与规避
abstract: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.
summary_zh: 边缘云推测解码受网络往返延迟限制，同步验证需等待完整往返时间，导致吞吐量下降。
提出SpecRelay系统：对需云验证请求采用异步验证流水线分摊往返开销；对本地可解请求通过路由器规避云验证。
异步调度使解码吞吐量提升50%；结合延迟感知路由器，在保持精度下系统吞吐量达基线1.95倍，仅47%请求发往云端。

title: Level Up! AI-Driven Challenges and Adaptations to Code Review Practices
title_zh: AI驱动的代码审查挑战与适应性调整研究
abstract: AI can write code faster than humans can review, causing a bottleneck and necessitating changes to code review practices. This bottleneck is hotly debated, giving rise to two extreme and orthogonal imagined futures: one where humans continue to be firmly entrenched in the review process, and one where AI agents merge pull requests entirely without human involvement. Yet, these futures remain rooted in folk wisdom. Through a mixed-methods study of interviews ($n = 24$) and a survey ($n = 2{,}590$) at a large, multinational software company with widespread access to AI, we identify AI-driven code review challenges and strategies reported as effective to meet them. We found that AI enables, necessitates, and complicates a shift in the human reviewer's role toward high-level concerns (e.g., design and intent). We found that AI-assisted authoring results in increased burden for reviewers due to challenges such as a lack of author stewardship and PR volume and size, potentially leading to downstream debt. Our survey showed AI review usage was not correlated with less difficulty keeping up with PR volume, indicating using AI for review alone is not sufficient for solving AI-driven review challenges. Developers found the most useful strategies to be organizations supporting and resourcing review, pushing review burden upstream, and prioritizing reviewer attention on the concerns that matter most.
summary_zh: AI生成代码速度远超人工审查，造成审查瓶颈，亟需调整现有代码审查实践。
通过访谈与问卷调查发现，AI辅助编写导致审查者负担加重，且仅用AI辅助审查无法有效缓解该瓶颈。
研究指出审查者角色需向设计等高层关注点转移，最有效策略为组织提供支持、上游分担负担及优先审查核心问题。

title: Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones
title_zh: 无标签自蒸馏方法STONE：通过垫脚石提升推理
abstract: Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.
summary_zh: 无标签自蒸馏中，模型对难题的多次尝试常不一致且投票易错，导致难以自我教导推理。
提出STONE方法，将一致性验证转移至模型自生成的较简单相关问题，用其解题过程教导原问题。
在五个数学基准上，STONE为Qwen3带来最高平均准确率，非思考模式下增益远超有标签的OPSD。
STONE全程无需标签，且推理时无需额外上下文或模型调用，实现了高效的无标签自蒸馏。

title: MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
title_zh: MemeEconomy：LLM代理会为生存而牺牲伦理吗？
abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.
summary_zh: 现有安全研究忽视LLM代理在模拟生存经济压力下的行为漏洞，本文提出MemeEconomy多模态市场模拟来检验此问题。
在生存压力下，10款前沿LLM的有害选择率平均上升15%，且在初始化时便承诺容忍伤害并抑制显式伤害确认。
基于BDI日志训练2B参数验证器MemeAgent，其内分布审计准确率达97.5%，且可泛化至外部多模态伤害基准。

title: Benchmark Factory: Agentic Benchmark Creation via Dataset Curation and Label-Free Quality Anchors
title_zh: Benchmark Factory：基于数据集构建与无标签质量锚点的智能基准测试生成
abstract: Teams deploying coding agents need benchmarks built from their own code, but curating and validating them by hand is resource intensive, and an unvalidated benchmark can mislead silently. We present Benchmark Factory, an autonomous meta-agent loop with human checkpoints: an LLM agent writes sourcing queries over landed production code changes, runs models of known relative strength on each candidate, diagnoses why a candidate fails, and repairs it by editing its queries, prompts, and configuration until it clears quality anchors that need no per-task human labels. We used Benchmark Factory to build benchmarks for five developer cohorts at our organization. Engineering raters scored a 5% sample 2.3 for task quality and 2.6 for grader verdicts on a 1-to-3 scale. On configurations never used to build them, the benchmarks ranked Claude Opus~4.7 at high reasoning effort above low effort (60.6% vs. 54.4% of tasks passed, $p=0.002$) and GPT-5.5 above GPT-5.4 (65.8% vs. 60.5%, $p=0.004$); 9 of the 10 per-cohort comparisons pointed the same way. A deliberately trivial benchmark failed the anchors; five broken graders failed them, even under a relaxed rule fixed in advance that the real grader passes; and with model labels shuffled so that no true ordering existed, random redraws of a candidate passed in at most 1.4% of simulations. The anchors are necessary, not sufficient, conditions for a valid benchmark, designed to focus human review on what the loop cannot repair.
summary_zh: 团队需基于自有代码构建编程智能体基准测试，但人工构建与验证成本高且未验证基准易产生误导。
提出Benchmark Factory，通过LLM智能体自动生成查询、诊断失败并修复，直至通过无需人工标签的质量锚点。
实验表明该基准能有效区分模型性能差异，且能成功拒绝无效基准与损坏评分器，将人工审查聚焦于无法自动修复之处。
comment: 5 pages, prepared for submission to AGENT 2027

title: We Have All the Cards: Securing Agent Cards at the Operational Trust Boundary of the Agent2Agent Protocol
abstract: AI agent interoperability protocols enable orchestrators to discover and invoke external agents using machine-readable metadata. In the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, Agent Cards contain attacker-controllable natural-language fields that may influence agent selection before a provider is invoked, creating a pre-invocation trust problem. We characterize this discovery-time attack surface through a taxonomy of ten Agent Card manipulation attacks and present SECCARD, a layered validation framework combining protocol checks, deterministic analysis, and LLM-based semantic reasoning. We measure the emerging public A2A ecosystem by probing 36.1 million Internet domains and collecting 310 deployed Agent Cards. Two annotators independently label the corpus with 96.8% agreement. We then construct a 660-card real-card perturbation benchmark with matched benign controls and a 260-card synthetic adversarial benchmark spanning all ten attack categories. On controlled attacks injected into real Agent Cards, the strongest semantic judge achieves 97.0% security recall at a 1.7% false-positive rate. Across nine LLM judges on the synthetic benchmark, security recall ranges from 25.8% to 92.3%, demonstrating substantial model-dependent variation. These results show that SECCARD effectively identifies Agent Card manipulations spanning all ten discovery-time attack classes while preserving benign Agent Cards, but also reveal that its effectiveness depends critically on the choice of the underlying LLM judge.
comment: To be published at the Workshop on Agentic AI in Offensive and Defensive Cyber Operations (AIDC'26) proceedings co-located with the IEEE Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC)

title: SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution
title_zh: SPLICE：结构化提示的局部迭代组合演化方法
abstract: Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.
summary_zh: 现有迭代NLO方法将提示视为单字符串，导致不安全全局重写、搜索坍塌和冗余膨胀等失效模式。
提出SPLICE框架，将NLO建模为对块结构、选择性可变状态的编辑图上的约束组合搜索，并映射对应保证。
实验表明SPLICE在7个基准上4胜3平，且在契约压力测试中严格保留安全条款，避免指标虚高。

title: RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding
title_zh: RAVEN-Bench：用于航空多模态理解的配对EO-IR视频QA基准
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yuhu990424/RAVEN-Bench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/TerraSenseAnalytics/RAVEN-Bench.
summary_zh: 现有MLLM在配对航空光电与红外(EO-IR)视频推理上的能力尚不明确，因目标小、视角变且线索常仅存于单模态。
提出RAVEN-Bench基准，含100对时序对齐的EO-IR视频及1200道人工审核多选题，支持单模态与配对评估。
评测发现总体准确率会高估EO-IR推理能力，该基准可诊断RGB视频基准的进步能否迁移至航空跨光谱理解。
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)

title: FiReIQ: Field-Level Confidence Estimation with Reasoning and Image Quality in Document Extraction
abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in structured document extraction, yet their deployment in high-stakes applications requires reliable confidence estimates for individual fields. Existing uncertainty estimators often aggregate signals across an entire generation, obscuring field-specific reasoning uncertainty while overlooking visual degradations that may lead to confident extraction errors. To address these limitations, we introduce FiReIQ, a field-level confidence estimation framework that combines field-aligned reasoning signals from a single VLM generation with local and global image-quality features through quality-conditioned visual fusion. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we further introduce FiReIQ-Bench, a benchmark spanning financial receipts and legal contracts. Experiments with two reasoning VLMs show that FiReIQ consistently improves confidence discrimination, selective prediction, and probabilistic accuracy over existing estimators. These gains extend to private financial service data, where FiReIQ improves AUROC by 6.8% and coverage at 95% precision by 10.6% over an existing baseline. Together, these results highlight the potential of FiReIQ to reduce manual review while enabling more reliable document automation.

title: Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token
abstract: Generating a token with a language model requires a fixed amount of arithmetic, whose energy sets a floor beneath any hardware. For Qwen3-1.7B at a 16K-token context, gate-level measurements at 5 nm place this floor at 0.89 mJ per token, yet an NVIDIA B300 spends 391-1,120x that. The excess is the price of generality, software layers, programmable hardware and moving weights and key-value (KV) caches from external memory, and it widens with each process generation. We present a co-design approach that brings token generation close to this floor and then lowers the floor itself, optimizing silicon and model together in a gate-level search loop. Fixing one model architecture in the datapath, with weights still loadable, and holding weights and every conversation's KV cache on-die, a pre-silicon 5 nm design brings an unchanged Qwen3-1.7B token to 3.4x its floor. Co-designing the model with the circuits at fixed quality lowers the floor to 0.29 mJ and the token to 0.52 mJ, 1.8x the new floor and less than the baseline model's arithmetic alone, while on-die capacity grows from one user to twelve. Against a measured B300 serving the same twelve users, the design decodes each user's tokens 110x faster at 690x lower energy. To show that one fixed architecture can serve, as a co-processor, the latency-critical workloads around a frontier model, we introduce Polyglot-DC (1.7B and 4B, each with its own design), specialized for each job by distillation and task-specific training into its own weights. As a drafter it speeds single-user speculative decoding of large open models by up to 6.6x at the maximum reasoning effort. Its guard returns multilingual verdicts in a millisecond or less, within a point of the strongest open guard. Its agent and financial-reasoning models lead comparable open models on established benchmarks, with a reasoning turn falling from seconds to tens of milliseconds.
comment: 62 pages plus references (72 total), 16 figures, 22 tables. Technical report

title: KUDEX: A Zero-Shot Decompositional Framework for Logical Analysis in Natural Language
abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generating fluent text, they often struggle with multi-step logical reasoning with inferential connections among statements. We introduce KUDEX (Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension), a novel zero-shot, decompositional framework for analyzing and verifying logical relationships in natural language.
